interpretations.exact_text: Beautiful, fair, dreamy--as one who sees visions in a cup. This is, however, only one of her aspects; she sees, but she also acts, and her activity feeds her dream.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Cups, Queen

interpretations.exact_text: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Cups, Queen

interpretations.exact_text: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.
